view_map.Section: axial section; flange front at Z=0, rear end at +Z
view_map.Detail A: enlarged axial section of annular grooves

features.rationale: Revolve the hollow stepped bushing with both annular grooves, front bore-entry bevel, flange rear chamfer and rear body bevel.
features.justification: The section's .56 extension locates the front root-side boundary of the internal groove; Detail A's .187 measures the theoretical root width. Apply the shown 6° draft to both mirror-image flanks. Coefficient 0.10510423526567647 is tan(6°), calculated from printed D035; coefficient 0.5773502691896257 is tan(30°), calculated from printed D025. These are evaluated trigonometric coefficients, not additional dimensions. The rear .09 gives the axial bevel extent. The printed 45° bore and flange bevels have equal radial and axial legs.

features.rationale: Apply the nominal root radius to both bottom corners of the external groove.
features.justification: Detail A shows matching root corners on the symmetric external groove.

features.rationale: Round both intersections of the internal groove root cylinder and drafted flanks.
features.justification: The groove root corners are mirror-image. The edge query selects both boundaries between the root cylinder and its adjacent conical walls.

features.rationale: Upper through mounting hole, counterbored from the flange front face.
Lower-left mounting hole at the dimensioned Cartesian location.
Lower-right mounting hole mirrored about the vertical centerline.
features.justification: The front view shows the lower holes mirror-image about the vertical centerline. Preserve printed Cartesian offsets rather than imposing an exact circular pattern.

features.rationale: Cut the downward-open flange slot with its semicircular closed end at the dimensioned center.
features.justification: Three matching open slots are visible. Their sides are tangent to the R.172 closed ends. The slot profile uses overall capsule length; the remote end extends outside the flange by D012, and the cut is through.

features.rationale: Cut the upper-right open slot at its dimensioned center.
features.justification: The front view shows the three slot directions related by nominal 120° rotational symmetry: the upper-right slot points at 30°. Keep the printed center offsets without polar rounding. Coefficient 0.8660254037844386 is cos(30°), calculated from this shown symmetric radial layout; sin(30°)=1/2. D012 extends the remote end past the OD.

features.rationale: Cut the upper-left open slot as the mirror of the upper-right slot.
features.justification: The two upper slots are mirror-image about the vertical centerline; their nominal directions are 30° and 150° in the shown threefold radial layout. Coefficient 0.8660254037844386 is cos(30°), evaluated from that layout. Preserve the printed Cartesian centers. The remote end extends beyond the flange.

features.rationale: What nominal size and chamfer-versus-radius treatment should be used at the external groove lips? The drawing specifies only a maximum.
What nominal size and chamfer-versus-radius treatment should be used at the internal groove lips? The drawing specifies only a maximum.
features.justification: Unexecuted placeholder. Intended edges are the two bore-to-groove-flank intersections only, excluding the front entry bevel. The operation and size fields do not establish a nominal edge break.

notes: Material: #18 AMPCO BRONZE; no heat treatment specified.
Nominal geometry is in inches. Axis X=Y=0; flange front face Z=0.
The flange rear .03 X 45° chamfer is included in the revolved profile before the open slots interrupt it.
Internal groove root location and width reference theoretical sharp corners before applying root fillets.
D001, 2.250 Ø REF., is non-controlling. Printed Cartesian positions take precedence over exact circular-pattern centers.
Counterbored mounting holes have through pilots; their counterbores are blind to D011.
D039 through D044 are derived extraction values; governing printed dimensions are used directly.
Datum A is the D023 main bore. Preserve D037 and D038, .0005 TIR to A, as inspection requirements.
The .221 Ø B designation requires IE 421. F/H texture classes and the 63 texture indication require IE 2122; no numerical interpretation is invented.
IE 507, IE 11, IE 421 and IE 2122 remain referenced manufacturing requirements. WK²=.005 is not used as geometry.
The unresolved C/R MAX treatments remain unapplied until nominal sizes and treatment types are selected.
